messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: itemtype for mixedmirt
parts:
Hi Phil,

Does mixedmirt support created itemtype? Manual seems not mention that. Thanks.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: itemtype for mixedmirt
parts:
Hey Keith,

No it does not, mostly because it would be too hard to track intercepts. It's possible that latent regression models could be supported in the future though (this might work in mirt(), but I'm not 100% sure), but currently they are not supported in mixedmirt(). Cheers.

Phil
